name: Ashby Ford
towns: Ashby Ford, the ford road and the river flats
summary: The river town at the old ford, with the bandstand, the feed store and the district's oldest houses.
body:
The river town at the old ford, with the bandstand, the feed store and the district's oldest houses. About 2,860 registered voters; 41 percent of them voted in the last county election.

Polling place on April 6: Ashby Ford Town Hall, 2 Bandstand Square, Ashby Ford. Early voting is at the county building in Marrow from March 22 to April 3.

name: Quillon Mills
towns: Quillon, Linden Street and the mill lofts
summary: A former mill village, now mostly first-shift families who work at the plants down the valley.
body:
A former mill village, now mostly first-shift families who work at the plants down the valley. About 3,420 registered voters; 33 percent of them voted in the last county election.

Polling place on April 6: Quillon Mills Methodist Hall, 118 Linden Street, Quillon. Early voting is at the county building in Marrow from March 22 to April 3.

name: Marrow Hill

body:

name: Sexton Ridge

body:

body:

name: Fallowmere
towns: Fallowmere Lake, the cabins and the old ranger station

body:
